items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: We had ZT.-- Zillion the T Randolph. Trumpet. And, my brother, Cag Johnson on trombone. And, in the rhythm section we had Teddy Wilson...

ctx.x: I never will forget, we went to Louisville, Kentucky. That Stomp's home town. And, Louie let Stomp take over quite a bit of things, because Stomp used to listen to Louie and he used to try to copy all his solos. He played pretty good.

But, anyway, getting back to ZT. ZT would write this hard music, then. But, this one, this is one time he did stick us. We really just couldn't play. We had -- oh, yeah. We had Scoville Brown in the band, too.
